caption: The video captures a large metal cylinder lowering onto a row of basketballs on coarse gravel. The blurred background and ground line remain largely fixed, so the visible motion is the cylinder descending toward the balls. From left to right, a partly hidden teal-and-black ball, an orange Spalding ball, a teal-and-black Spalding ball, and a green-and-black ball sit beneath it. The bottom edge of the metal steadily closes the gap above the balls, while the horizontal seam moves down with the cylinder. The orange ball compresses, its height shrinking as its top sinks and sides bulge. The central teal Spalding ball flattens, and its printed logo tilts and shifts as the sphere squashes. The green-and-black ball compresses too, its green panel bulging outward. The leftmost teal-and-black ball becomes more exposed as the orange ball deforms, while the balls remain pressed and distorted.
